Electrician Job at Gemameg Company Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        Gemameg Company Nigeria Limited is a consultancy firm with the aim of providing services to the society. We recruit in the following areas: yard cleaners, plant operatives, sweepers and cleaners, cooks/chefs, accountants, engineers, drivers, VSR drivers, office support, technical support staff, merchandisers, sales representatives, marketers, and skilled and unskilled workers.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Electrician

Job Location: Igere Remo, Ogun

Key Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Perform installation, routine maintenance, and repairs on power control systems, lighting systems, electrical panels, and other building electrical components.
	Accurately troubleshoot and diagnose electrical malfunctions, effectively interpreting technical diagrams and engineering drawings.
	Install and configure safety and distribution components, including switches, resistors, and circuit-breaker panels.
	Execute maintenance and repair tasks for kitchen and laundry equipment, involving component inspection and replacement of faulty parts.
	Inspect, maintain, and ensure the optimal performance of smoke detectors, fire alarm systems, and related safety equipment.


Requirements & Qualifications


	Candidates should possess an OND or HND in electrical engineering, or an equivalent trade test certification in electrical.
	A minimum of 4 years of proven experience as an electrician, with a strong focus on electrical maintenance.
	Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and repair complex electrical systems independently.
	Physical stamina and the ability to handle electrical equipment and work extended hours on installation or maintenance sites as required.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV or Application details to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Account Officer",
  "description": "Virgin Forest Energy Limited is a wholly-owned and well capitalized Nigerian energy downstream oil trading company. We are dedicated to the provision of top-rate petroleum products and by-products to our vast array of clients and customers across Nigeria and beyond. In the course of our short but eventful existence as a corporate entity, we have carved a niche for ourselves as a company sensitive to the peculiar environment in which we operate, and we have tailored our operations in response to the ever-changing demands of a vibrant and dynamic emerging economy such as Nigeria.

We are &nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Account Officer

Job Location: Lagos

Description


	We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and highly organised Account Officer to join our team.


Key Responsibilities


	Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial and accounting records.
	Record and process daily financial transactions, including invoices, receipts, payments, and expenses.
	Prepare and maintain ledgers, journals, reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
	Prepare monthly financial reports and management accounts.

        Virgin Forest Energy Limited is a wholly-owned and well capitalized Nigerian energy downstream oil trading company. We are dedicated to the provision of top-rate petroleum products and by-products to our vast array of clients and customers across Nigeria and beyond. In the course of our short but eventful existence as a corporate entity, we have carved a niche for ourselves as a company sensitive to the peculiar environment in which we operate, and we have tailored our operations in response to the ever-changing demands of a vibrant and dynamic emerging economy such as Nigeria.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Account Officer

Job Location: Lagos

Description

	We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and highly organised Account Officer to join our team.


Key Responsibilities


	Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial and accounting records.

	Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
